checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Reads Printmakers' / Open Studio over two lines. The apostrophe is curly.
"9 October 2027" and "11:00–17:00" both read correctly, with an en dash in the time.
Four lines in the correct order: Unit 14B, Second Floor, / The Old Foundry Arts Centre, / 127–129 St. John's Road, / Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB.

must.item: Preserves en dash, period, apostrophe, commas
must.why: The en dash, the period after St, and all commas are present. The apostrophe is curly rather than straight, which is a typographic variant.

must.item: Address legible, inside canvas, no truncation
must.why: The address is small but clear, centred and well inside the margins.

must.item: Single portrait 4:5, black and cream, no extra wording
must.why: The final image is 512x640, which is 4:5, in black on cream, with only two thin decorative rules and no extra words. Image 1 is only the square cream background, an intermediate step.

exact_text.text: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB
exact_text.read_as: Unit 14B, Second Floor, / The Old Foundry Arts Centre, / 127–129 St. John’s Road, / Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB (curly apostrophe)

faults.what: Apostrophes are curly (’) rather than straight ('), as the assistant warned. This is minor typographic fidelity.
The address is fairly small relative to the title, but still legible.
Resolution is low (512x640). The output also includes an unused intermediate square cream image.

summary: The final flyer is a clean 4:5 black-on-cream design with all text correct, including the en dashes and the full four-line address; the only flaw is curly apostrophes.
